7455.title: Plugin-attributed turn requests incorrectly acknowledge unread history
7455.rootCauseOneLine: The automatic read-state updater acknowledges plugin-attributed user turn requests without checking their originPluginId.

prReviews.topFinding: The guard excludes plugin-attributed user requests at the verified policy boundary; the PR branch was not executed.

7455.proposedFix: Skip implicit read acknowledgement for plugin-attributed turn requests at the existing event-append policy boundary.
7455.caveats: Server persistence reproduced twice; native desktop and phone rendering were not exercised. No duplicate fix was pushed because PR #7456 is open. Complete reproduction code is inline in the report.
